correctness.rationale: Imported primary spectral-fusion Remark 4 establishes root order exactly 2n−1 at t=π. With x=cos(t/2), the Chebyshev expansion has only odd indices 2λ_k and nonzero top coefficient, so P is odd of degree 2λ_n. Removing the x^{2n−1} factor leaves an even Q of degree 2λ_n−2n+1. Distinct positive x∈(0,1) roots consume paired degree with negative x at equal multiplicity. Real-analytic variable change has nonzero derivative for t∈(0,π); hence ESE count ≤degQ/2. Independent exact degree tests at n=2,3,4 confirm boundary λ_n=n−1/2 gives zero budget; proof all parameters analytic.

final_claim: For order-2n reduced symmetric first-PST-time-π chains, with positive half-integer λ_k and 2λ_k odd, number of return-amplitude ESE roots with multiplicity in (0,π) is ≤ λ_n−n+1/2.
